notes: Summaries: for impulse/burst categories, per-event values are reduced to a per-file median (events with snr_db < 20 dB and clipped events excluded), then median/p25/p75 across files.

Freesound items were analysed from the HQ Ogg Vorbis previews (lossy); analysed_samplerate is the preview's rate, original_samplerate the uploaded file's. Bands whose centre lies above a detected codec low-pass (codec_lowpass_hz) and bands above Nyquist are null (invalid).
SESA (16 kHz) and ESC-50 / FIT groups are kept separate from curated_all. In SESA the 8k and 16k octave bands are invalid (Nyquist 8 kHz) and centroids are biased low.
Continuous sources were reduced to the loudest 20 s window (1 s steps) after trimming digital silence; segment start is recorded per source.
Tags: close (<~15 m / at the shooter), mid (~20-100 m), distant (>~100 m or described as distant), unspecified (not stated by uploader). Tags come from uploader descriptions.
explosion subtype_gun_blast = artillery/mortar/tank/naval gun firing (muzzle blast), subtype_detonation = grenades, IED/demolition, quarry/chimney blasting.
